title: 49 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Balance)
description:
Learn 49 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Balance · Usawa
1:22  Shopping & Prices · Ununuzi na Bei
2:43  Travel & Airport · Usafiri na Uwanja wa Ndege
3:57  Cultural Traditions · Jadi za Kitamaduni

7:51  Success · Mafanikio
9:15  Positive Life · Maisha Chanya

PHRASE LIST

BALANCE · Usawa
• I need calm, right now. - Nahitaji utulivu, sasa hivi.  [NahitajI utulivu, sAsa hvihI.]
• I’m choosing peace over speed. - Ninakuchagua amani kuliko kasi.  [NinakuchAgua amani kUiko kasi.]
• Settle your mind, then act. - Tulia akili yako, kisha fanya.  [TuliA akilI yako, kishA fanya.]
• Keep your weight steady, please. - Shikilia uzito wako kwa utulivu, tafadhali.  [ShikiliA uzitO wako kwa utulivu, tafadhali.]
• I’m finding rhythm in my routine. - Ninatafuta mdundo ndani ya ratiba yangu.  [NinatAfuta mdUndo ndani yA ratiba yangU.]
• Balance your phone time today. - Pangeni muda wa simu kwa usawa leo.  [PangEni muda wa simU kwa usawA leo.]

SHOPPING & PRICES · Ununuzi na Bei
• How much is this one exactly? - Bei yake ni kiasi gani hasa?  [Bei yaKE ni KAshi gani HA-SA?]
• Do you have it in black? - Je, una rangi nyeusi?  [Je, U-na rAN-gi NYEu-si?]
• Is there a discount for bulk? - Kuna punguzo ukiya kuchukua kwa wingi?  [KU-na punGU-zo u-ki-ya ku-CHI-ku-a kwa WIN-gi?]
• What’s the price after bargaining? - Bei itashuka hadi kiasi gani ukipunguza?  [Bei i-ta-SHA-ka hadi KAshi gani u-ki-punGU-za?]
• Can I try it on quickly? - Naweza kujaribu haraka, tafadhali?  [Na-WE-za ku-jaRIB-u haRA-ka, ta-faDHaa-li?]
• Does it come with a warranty? - Inakuja na dhamana?  [IN-a-ku-ja na dha-MA-na?]
• Is this good quality, really? - Hii ina ubora mzuri kweli?  [Hii i-na uBO-ra mzU-ri KWEL-i?]

TRAVEL & AIRPORT · Usafiri na Uwanja wa Ndege
• Where are the baggage carousels? - Ukipakuzi wa mizigo upo wapi?  [UKIpakuzi wa miGOGO uPo wapi?]
• I need help with my suitcase. - Naomba msaada na koti langu.  [NaOMba MSAada na KOti LANGU.]
• Is there a currency exchange here? - Kuna kubadilisha fedha hapa?  [Kuna kuBADilisha FEda haPA?]
• Where can I buy a SIM card? - Ninaweza kununua SIM card wapi?  [NinaWEza kuNUNua SIM CARD wapi?]
• How much is a taxi to town? - Teaxi hadi mjini inagharimu kiasi gani?  [TEaksi haDi mJINi inaGHARimu KIasi gani?]
• Does this airport have free Wi-Fi? - Je, uwanja huu una Wi-Fi ya bure?  [Je, uwanJA huu una Wi-Fi ya BURe?]

CULTURAL TRADITIONS · Jadi za Kitamaduni
• When guests arrive, we serve chai immediately. - Wageni wakifika, tunawaletea chai mara moja.  [WAGEni WAKifika, tunawaletea CHAI mara MOJA.]
• We remove shoes before entering homes. - Tunavua viatu kabla ya kuingia ndani ya nyumba.  [Tunavua VIatu kabla ya KUIingia ndani ya NYUMBA.]
• At funerals, we sit quietly together. - Kwenye misiba, tunakaa kimya pamoja.  [KWENye MI-siba, tunakaa KIMYA PAmOja.]
• After marriage, friends sing by the gate. - Baada ya harusi, marafiki huimba karibu na lango.  [BAada ya ha-RU-si, maraFAiki huIMba karibu na LANgo.]
• We listen to elders first, then we decide. - Tunawasikiliza wazee kwanza, kisha tunapanga.  [TunawasiKiLIza WAZEE kwanza, KISha tunapanga.]
• On holidays, kids do a short group dance. - Siku za sikukuu, watoto hufanya densi fupi ya pamoja.  [Siku za si-KUkuu, WAToto hufanya DENSI FUPI ya PAmoja.]

BANKING & MONEY · Benki na Pesa
• Where can I exchange cash? - Ninaweza kubadilisha fedha wapi?  [NinaWEZA kubADILISHA FEHAda wapi?]
• Is there a minimum deposit today? - Kuna amana ya chini kiasi gani leo?  [KUNA amANA ya CHINI kiasi gani LEO?]
• I forgot my PIN, please help. - Nimesahau PIN, naomba msaada.  [NiMESAHAu PIN, naOMBA MSAada.]
• How long does a transfer take? - Uhamisho huchukua muda gani?  [uHAMISHo huCHUka muDA gani?]
• I received a text from the bank. - Nimepokea ujumbe mfupi kutoka benki.  [NiMepoKEA ujumbe MFiupi kuTOka benki.]
• Is my international transfer possible? - Uhamisho wa kimataifa unawezekana?  [uHAMISHo wa KImaataifa uNAwezekana?]

ASKING FOR DIRECTIONS · Kuuliza Njia
• Where can I catch the bus? - Ninaweza kupata basi wapi?  [NINAWEZA kupata BASSI wapi?]
• How do I get to the station? - Nifike stesheni vipi?  [NIFIKE STE-SHE-ni vipi?]
• Is there parking nearby, please? - Kuna sehemu ya kuegesha karibu?  [KUNA SEHEMU ya KUEGESHA karibu?]
• Which turn do I take next? - Nigeuze upande gani baadaye?  [ni-GEU-ze UPANDE gani baA-DE?]
